scope: 44 TypeScript native.ts callable annotations for prepared transport and explicit private checks. No requirement or implementation status change.
source_comparison: Frozen Temporal proposal via checklist rows. ECMA-262 remains requested authority.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §3.5.4 step 4.
// Guard legacy JSON parse input against escaped code units.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Only the JSON branch checks parse-prefixed operations and flags escape sequences before UTF-8 transport. The typed invocation bypasses this guard and owns its input processing. This is a narrow legacy parse-path check.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §12.3.31 step 2.a, §12.3.30 field requirements.
// Check prepared non-ISO era pairs and month-day year information.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Rejects exactly-one-era-field for selected non-ISO calendars and a non-ISO month-day with numeric month, absent month code and absent year indicators. Operates on prepared fields; complete calendar-field resolution stays downstream.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §11.1.11 step 1.
// Marshal prepared ISO fields for possible epoch lookup.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Copies prepared ISO date scalars and own optional clock fields into a null-prototype record; timeZoneResolve consumes this copy for candidate lookup. It does not call user conversion or determine candidates.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §11.1.10 step 2.
// Transport the exact epoch to the ISO field projection.
reviewed_rows.evidence: The epochNanosecondsToISO caller sends decimal BigInt text; this shared request builder forwards optional typed ISO fields and day count for other operations. Native operation owns projection.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §8.5.5 step 1, §4.5.18 step 4.
// Transport prepared epoch or clock addition operands.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Forwards exact epoch or clock text, typed duration and subtract flag, then converts returned decimal string to BigInt. Arithmetic stays in backend.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §4.5.2 step 3.
// Decode native clock fields into a prepared time result.
reviewed_rows.evidence: String path normalizes by day modulo, projects clock fields and retains BigInt. Snapshot path adapts supplied native fields. Both Number clock values are bounded below 2^47 and exact; this is a private adapter result.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §8.5.10 step 6.
// Marshal prepared duration fields for native instant addition.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Typed invocation passes the prepared duration unchanged; JSON branch copies own fields as exact decimal text. Public ToTemporalDuration and internal time arithmetic are separate.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §12.3.12 step 2.
// Marshal prepared calendar-date conversion fields.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Projects year/day and present month/monthCode into a private request used by calendarToEpochDay; native code owns calendar arithmetic and overflow.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §3.5.11 steps 1, 4, §9.5.6 steps 1, 5, §10.5.3 steps 1, 5.
// Marshal the private date and calendar for short formatting.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Copies epoch day and calendar, supplying date, year-month and month-day backend formatters with already selected slot state.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.5.4 steps 4, 6, 14.
// Marshal the private zoned epoch, identifier and calendar.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Copies a prepared ZonedSlot to a private request record and retains epoch exactly as decimal BigInt text.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §7.3.20 steps 27.b, 27.c, 27.d, 28.c, 28.e.
// Marshal the prepared zoned or plain duration anchor.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Selects zoned/date shape from a prepared RelativeTo record, then copies epoch and calendar. Public relativeTo option Get/conversion is upstream.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §3.5.3 steps 4, 5.
// Decode prepared date and calendar values for slot creation.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Pairs returned epoch day and supplied calendar on scalar path; otherwise tags optional adapter snapshot ownership. Public object allocation remains in the caller.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §5.5.8 steps 4, 5, §6.5.3 steps 4, 5, 6.
// Decode the exact epoch and metadata for slot creation.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Converts decimal BigInt epoch, carries optional calendar and zone, and tags supplied snapshot ownership. Does not construct public instances.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §3.3.23 steps 7, 10, §9.3.13 steps 7, 10, §10.3.6 steps 7, 10.
// Forward date or short-date field merge and conversion.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Selects backend operation by shape and sends prepared fields and overflow through typed ISO path or generic request. Public Gets and conversion already occurred.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §5.3.25 steps 13, 16.
// Forward date-time field merge and conversion.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends exact local epoch, calendar, prepared fields and overflow; private guard and result decoding surround backend call.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.3.31 steps 18, 23, 25.
// Forward zoned field merge and offset interpretation.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends prepared zoned slot, fields and selected overflow, disambiguation and offset behavior; Rust owns merge and offset interpretation.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §12.3.26 steps 1.b, 2.
// Forward the date slot for calendar field projection.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends calendar, epoch, extended-range flag and optional exact clock context to native calendarProperties for a projection snapshot.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.3.8 steps 3, 4.
// Forward the zoned slot for local and calendar projection.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Passes an exact zoned slot to native zonedProperties. Receiver brand checks and public field selection stay in callers.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §9.5.8 steps 11, 12, 14.
// Forward year-month calendar addition and projection.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends prepared short slot, duration, sign and overflow to either backend entry. Caller owns option reads and public allocation.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §9.5.7 steps 13, 16.e, 18.
// Forward year-month difference, rounding and direction.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Passes both prepared slots, rounding settings and since flag. Native difference owns private calendar arithmetic.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §9.3.23 steps 7, 8.
// Forward the reference month and prepared day.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends the validated day and calendar-bearing short slot to native date conversion. Public item Gets and date object allocation stay upstream and downstream respectively.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §10.3.12 steps 7, 8.
// Forward the reference month-day and prepared year.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends prepared year and calendar-bearing short slot to native constrained date conversion.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §3.5.11 steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
// Forward date and calendar display to native formatting.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Selects typed formatter or named request with short slot and prepared calendar display. String construction is in the formatter.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §5.5.9 steps 4, 5, 6, 7.
// Forward date-time precision and calendar display.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Forwards exact local epoch, calendar, prepared precision and rounding mode. Native formatter computes clock and calendar parts.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §9.5.6 steps 4.a, 5, 7.
// Forward the reference day and calendar display.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Forwards prepared short slot and display mode; native formatting owns whether the reference date appears.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §10.5.3 steps 4.a, 5, 7.
// Forward the reference year and calendar display.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Forwards prepared short slot and display mode; native formatting owns whether reference year appears.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.5.4 steps 5, 9, 11.a, 13.b, 14, 15.
// Forward zoned precision and annotation display.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Both paths transport the private zoned slot and prepared precision, rounding and display choices. Native formatting owns the output.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §12.3.31 steps 1.e, 1.f, 1.g, §12.3.12 step 2.
// Check required ISO fields before native date conversion.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Missing year/day/both month forms are rejected locally. Typed or generic ISO calendar conversion owns agreement, overflow and arithmetic.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §3.5.4 steps 4, 5.
// Forward the plain date string to native parsing.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends text to the typed or generic parsePlainDate operation and decodes the result. Public options and slot construction stay outside.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §5.5.6 steps 4, 5.
// Forward the plain date-time string to native parsing.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Selects typed or generic text parser, then restores exact local epoch result.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §9.5.2 steps 4, 14.
// Forward the year-month string to native parsing and projection.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends raw text to the specialized parser and restores the returned reference date/calendar slot. No public overflow Get here.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §10.5.1 steps 4, 10.b, 15.
// Forward the month-day string to native parsing and projection.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends raw text to the specialized parser and restores the returned reference date/calendar slot. Native implementation owns both calendar branches.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.5.2 steps 5.b, 5.c, 5.f.
// Forward zoned string parsing and unpack its fields.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Calls typed parseZonedFields or forwards text and restores prepared fields, zone and offset with null normalized to unset.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.5.2 step 11.
// Forward prepared offset matching and disambiguation.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Passes local epoch, zone, calendar, offset and all matching choices including date-only and minute match. Native resolution owns selection and errors.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.5.10 step 8.
// Forward zoned duration addition with overflow and sign.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends a private zoned slot, prepared duration, direction and overflow to the native provider. Exact epoch and metadata are decoded afterward.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.5.9 steps 5.a, 9.
// Forward both zoned endpoints and difference settings.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Marshals both exact endpoints, rounding choices and since direction; native backend owns time-only and calendar-unit difference arithmetic.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.3.39 steps 19.i, 20.a, 20.c.
// Forward zoned day or clock rounding.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends prepared unit, increment and rounding mode with the receiver slot. Native code owns day progress or local clock rounding and resolution.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.3.45 step 6, §6.5.1 step 1.c.
// Forward the zoned start-of-day calculation.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends the prepared slot and optional explicit day to typed/generic backend and restores the exact epoch. Destination does not select or resolve midnight here.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §6.3.23 steps 7, 8, 9, 10.
// Forward the zoned day-length calculation.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Sends the zoned slot and returns native hours result. Two day starts and exact elapsed arithmetic are computed natively.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §3.5.15 step 7.
// Forward prepared calendar-date addition.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Passes epoch day, calendar, duration, direction and overflow to typed or generic native path; native code owns calendar addition.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §5.5.16 steps 6, 8, 9.
// Forward date-time addition and calendar balancing.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Passes exact local epoch and prepared duration plus direction/overflow; native provider owns clock carry and calendar addition.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §3.5.14 steps 6, 8.e, 10.
// Forward date difference, optional rounding and direction.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Passes both epoch days, calendar, prepared rounding settings and since flag to the date difference implementation.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §5.5.15 steps 6, 8.
// Forward date-time difference, rounding and direction.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Passes exact local epoch endpoints, calendar, prepared rounding settings and since flag to the date-time difference implementation.

reviewed_rows.annotation:
// Temporal comparison §5.5.11 steps 2, 3, 4.
// Forward local clock rounding and day carry.
reviewed_rows.evidence: Passes local epoch/calendar and prepared unit, increment and mode. Native result becomes a prepared DateTimeSlot.

validation.result: 7 Bazel targets passed in the same validation batch.
